untranslated: Preview PDF-compatible Adobe Illustrator files in your browser. Zoom, browse available pages, and export previews as PNG or JPG. Files stay on your device.
Illustrator Editing & Native Layers: Not supported. PDF.js is a high-fidelity document renderer, not an Illustrator vector editor.
Multi-page Artboards: When saved with PDF compatibility, available PDF pages in the stream correspond to exported artboards.
How does this viewer open .ai files?

When saving in Adobe Illustrator, the "Create PDF Compatible File" option is enabled by default. This bundles a complete PDF vector preview stream inside the .ai container. Our viewer parses this stream 100% locally using Mozilla PDF.js.
Why do some .ai files say "No readable preview"?

If an Illustrator file was saved with "Create PDF Compatible File" disabled or in legacy Illustrator 8 format, it contains only proprietary PostScript code and no PDF data. Simply re-save the file in Illustrator with PDF compatibility enabled.
Can I export high-resolution PNG or JPG?

Yes. You can select 1x (72 DPI), 2x (144 DPI), 3x (216 DPI), or 4x (300 DPI print quality) from the resolution dropdown. PNG exports preserve vector transparency, while JPG exports include a solid white background.
Is my artwork uploaded to any server?
Never. File decoding, vector rasterization, and image generation run entirely within your browser's Web Worker sandbox. No file data is ever transmitted across the internet.
